winter.note: Start with bare hands and no hat to validate the base fit. Hats and gloves are separate later accessories.

quality_gates: Style comparison passes before pose and wardrobe production.
Full figure contains head, hands and both feet with margins.
Keep moderate female body diversity; exclude extreme or distorted proportions.
Original identity remains stable across expressions and garments.
Clothes fit the exact selected body and pose; no one-size overlay stretching.
No logos, signatures, accidental text, robotic faces or plastic skin.
Every shipped layer has verified alpha, exact canvas, anchor and source lineage.
note: This file defines the next production families; it does not claim those images or layered rigs are already drawn.
